description: Check an AI-written email before sending. Returns allow, delay, requires_approval or block with reason codes (recipient validity, sender authentication, content risk, sensitive industries, volume limits) and recommendations. Does not send email. Without an API key: 3 free checks per day per IP.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (API key callers); used for per-agent limits

from_email.description: Sender address the agent will send from

intent.description: Purpose, for example cold_outbound or follow_up

policy.description: Policy: default, balanced, strict, growth, enterprise, healthcare or recruiting

recipient_country.description: Recipient country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example DE

recipient_source.description: Where the address came from, for example apollo, website, referral

relationship.description: Relationship, for example new_prospect or existing_customer

name: preflight_email
title: Preflight an outbound email
